svg.title: Wealth poverty: adults under $25,000, yearly average: the C2.2 design against no programme, 20 years
svg.text: Wealth poverty: adults under $25,000, yearly average: the C2.2 design against no programme, 20 years
Each dot is one preregistered reading, sorted by its effect, with its 95% seed interval (unit: points).
Ringed: the main row. Diamond: the least-favourable bound. Shaded: not material (rule 3). Below each panel: the curve's verdict (rule 2).
Paid for by the Source (main row: full backing, a design parameter)
